Tier 3 spares — six alternates

One per world, made after the film was signed off. None of these is in the cut. Each is a different moment or camera from anything already on screen, built from that world's approved anchor so grade and light carry.

Screened the same way as the 19 back-half plates: numeric clone test against the anchor (below 22 = near-copy; all six are 36–53), then eye check for baked lettering, glyph-like marks and recognisable faces. T3-A05 was re-shot once because its first version had stamp impressions that read as glyph-like designs. Masters are 3840×2160 PNG; no clips exist for these, so using one means a single re-cut at that shot's existing duration and recipe.
